title: BHTML+BCSS
statementMd:
*This problem is about imaginary languages BHTML and BCSS, which slightly resemble HTML and CSS. Read the problem statement carefully as the resemblance is rather slight and the problem uses very simplified analogs.* You are given a BHTML document that resembles HTML but is much simpler. It is recorded as a sequence of opening and closing tags. A tag that looks like "``" is called an opening tag and a tag that looks like "``" is called a closing tag. Besides, there are self-closing tags that are written as "``" and in this problem they are fully equivalent to "``". All tagnames in this problem are strings consisting of lowercase Latin letters with length from 1 to 10 characters. Tagnames of different tags may coincide. The document tags form a correct bracket sequence, that is, we can obtain an empty sequence from the given one using the following operations: - remove any self-closing tag "``", - remove a pair of an opening and a closing tag that go consecutively (in this order) and have the same names. In other words, remove substring "``". For example, you may be given such document: "`

`" but you may not be given documents "``", "``", "``" or "``". Obviously, for any opening tag there is the only matching closing one — each such pair is called an *element*. A self-closing tag also is an element. Let's consider that one element is nested inside another one, if tags of the first element are between tags of the second one. An element is not nested to itself. For instance, in the example above element "`b`" is nested in "`header`" and in "`p`", but it isn't nested in "`a`" and "`footer`", also it isn't nested to itself ("`b`"). Element "`header`" has three elements nested in it, and "`footer`" has zero. We need the BCSS rules to apply styles when displaying elements of the BHTML documents. Each rule is recorded as a subsequence of words "`x1 x2 ... xn`". This rule has effect over all such elements $*t*$, which satisfy both conditions from the list: - there is a sequence of nested elements with tagnames "`x1`", "`x2`", ..., "`xn`" (that is, the second element is nested in the first one, the third element is nested in the second one and so on), - this sequence ends with element $*t*$ (i.e. tagname of element $*t*$ equals "`xn`"). For example, element "`b`" meets the conditions of the rule "`a b`" if for element "`b`" exists element "`a`" in which it is nested. Element "`c`" meets the conditions of the rule "`a b b c`", if three elements exist: "`a`", "`b`", "`b`", and in the chain "`a`"-"`b`"-"`b`"-"`c`" each following element is nested in the previous one. Given a BHTML document and a set of BCSS rules, write a program that determines the number of elements that meet the conditions of each rule. ## Input The first line of the input contains a BHTML-document. The document has length from $4$ to $10^{6}$ characters. The document has a correct structure, doesn't contain spaces or any other unnecessary characters. Tagnames consist of lowercase Latin letters, their lengths are from 1 to 10 characters. The second line contains an integer $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 200$) — the number of queries. Then $*m*$ lines contain the queries, one per line. Each query is a sequence $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$, where $*x*_{*i*}$ is the $*i*$-th element of the query, and $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200$) is the number of elements in the query. The elements are separated by single spaces. Each query doesn't begin with and doesn't end with a space. Each query element is a sequence of lowercase Latin letters with length from 1 to 10. ## Output Print $*m*$ lines, the $*j*$-th line should contain the number of elements of the document that correspond to the $*j*$-th BCSS-rule. If there are no such elements at all, print on the line `0`.
statementZhMd:
*本题涉及虚构的语言 BHTML 和 BCSS，它们与 HTML 和 CSS 略有相似之处。请仔细阅读题面，因为这种相似性相当有限，而且题目使用的是非常简化的类比。* 给定一个类似于 HTML 但更加简单的 BHTML 文档。它由一系列开始标签和结束标签组成。形如“``”的标签称为开始标签，形如“``”的标签称为结束标签。此外，还存在形如“``”的自闭合标签，在本题中它与“``”完全等价。题目中的所有标签名都是由小写拉丁字母组成的字符串，长度为 1 到 10。不同标签的标签名可能相同。 文档中的标签构成一个正确的括号序列，也就是说，可以通过以下操作将给定序列变为空序列： - 删除任意自闭合标签“``”； - 删除一对连续出现的开始标签和结束标签（顺序必须如此），且它们的名称相同。换句话说，删除子串“``”。 例如，可能给出如下文档：“`

`”，但不可能给出文档“``”、“``”、“``”或“``”。 显然，对于每个开始标签，都唯一对应一个结束标签——每一对这样的标签称为一个*元素*。自闭合标签也算作一个元素。如果一个元素的标签位于另一个元素的标签之间，则称前者嵌套在后者中。元素不会嵌套在自身中。例如，在上面的例子中，元素“`b`”嵌套在“`header`”和“`p`”中，但不嵌套在“`a`”和“`footer`”中，也不嵌套在自身（“`b`”）中。元素“`header`”中嵌套了三个元素，而“`footer`”中没有嵌套任何元素。 我们需要使用 BCSS 规则来为显示 BHTML 文档中的元素时应用样式。每条规则都记录为单词“`x1 x2 ... xn`”的一个子序列。满足以下两个条件的所有元素 $*t*$ 都会受到该规则的影响： - 存在一个标签名依次为“`x1`”、“`x2`”、……、“`xn`”的嵌套元素序列（也就是说，第二个元素嵌套在第一个元素中，第三个元素嵌套在第二个元素中，以此类推）； - 该序列以元素 $*t*$ 结尾（即元素 $*t*$ 的标签名等于“`xn`”）。 例如，如果元素“`b`”所嵌套的元素中存在元素“`a`”，则元素“`b`”满足规则“`a b`”的条件。如果存在三个元素：“`a`”、“`b`”、“`b`”，并且在“`a`”-“`b`”-“`b`”-“`c`”这条链中，每个后继元素都嵌套在前一个元素中，则元素“`c`”满足规则“`a b b c`”的条件。 给定一个 BHTML 文档和一组 BCSS 规则，请编写程序，确定满足每条规则条件的元素数量。 ## 输入格式 输入的第一行包含一个 BHTML 文档。文档长度为 $4$ 到 $10^{6}$ 个字符。文档结构正确，不包含空格或其他多余字符。标签名由小写拉丁字母组成，长度为 1 到 10。 第二行包含一个整数 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 200$）——查询数量。接下来 $*m*$ 行每行包含一个查询。每个查询是一列 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$，其中 $*x*_{*i}$ 是查询的第 $*i$ 个元素，$*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200$）是查询中元素的数量。元素之间由单个空格分隔。每个查询的开头和结尾都没有空格。查询中的每个元素都是由小写拉丁字母组成的字符串，长度为 1 到 10。 ## 输出格式 输出 $*m*$ 行，第 $*j*$ 行应包含文档中满足第 $*j*$ 条 BCSS 规则的元素数量。如果不存在任何这样的元素，则在该行输出 `0`。
